turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Hello, doctor. I’m here for my annual blood pressure check; otherwise things have been pretty stable. I only have occasional knee pain from my osteoarthritis, and I use acetaminophen as needed.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling—just occasional knee discomfort. There’s no other new pain or swelling elsewhere.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. My scalp looks normal to me, and I haven’t had any new skin changes elsewhere.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on my body.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t have trouble lifting my arms above my head. I can raise them normally without pain or weakness.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision, and there’s been no vision change that comes with or without pain.

turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any fevers like that, and I haven’t felt dizzy or extremely uncomfortable from an illness. I’ve been feeling pretty stable overall, aside from the occasional knee pain.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t been unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately. My day-to-day routine feels pretty steady, and my focus is mostly on keeping up with my blood pressure check and daily exercise.

turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any burning or discomfort when I urinate. Everything feels normal in that regard, and I haven’t noticed any new urinary symptoms.

turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any chills or shaking. I’ve been feeling stable overall, with only the occasional knee discomfort from my osteoarthritis.

turns.patient_answer: No, doctor—I don’t have any breast masses or lumps at all, fixed or otherwise, and nothing feels unusual there.

turns.doctor_question: Are you feeling any pain or discomfort in the side area of your abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: No, doctor—I don’t feel any pain or discomfort in the side area of my abdomen between my ribs and hips. I’ve been feeling stable overall.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: No, doctor—my urine hasn’t looked darker than usual, and I haven’t noticed any color change. I’ve had no urinary symptoms otherwise, just the usual stable routine.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any difficulty moving your arm up or across your body?
turns.patient_answer: No, doctor—I can move my arms up and across my body normally without any pain or weakness. The only discomfort I’ve had is occasional knee pain related to my osteoarthritis.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your joints feel sore or stiff after doing the same activity repeatedly, like after a long day of typing, lifting, or other repetitive motions?
turns.patient_answer: Yes, doctor—my knees can feel a bit sore or stiff after I’ve been on them for a long time, but it’s usually mild and related to my osteoarthritis. I don’t notice stiffness in other joints, and it improves with rest.
